SELECT 'SHIP' AS kind, SD.OrderNo, SD.OrderProdNo, SD.OrderChangeNo, SD.OrderName, SD.ShopCode, SD.ShopName, SD.ChnlCode, Ch.ChnlName, SD.ProdCode, SD.ProdName, SD.ItemName, SD.ProdQty, SD.SalePrice, SD.SupplyPrice, SD.BuyPrice, SD.VatRate, SD.DeliFeeAmt, SD.InvNo, SD.OrderState, SD.ShipCmpletDate AS cmpletDate FROM shopwizard.tShpShipDirect SD INNER JOIN shopwizard.tCmpChnl Ch ON Ch.ChnlCode = SD.ChnlCode WHERE (SD.ShipCmpletDate IS NOT NULL AND SD.ShipCmpletDate != '')
UNION ALL SELECT 'RETURN' AS kind, RD.OrderNo, RD.OrderProdNo, RD.OrderChangeNo, RD.OrderName, RD.ShopCode, RD.ShopName, RD.ChnlCode, Ch.ChnlName, RD.ProdCode, RD.ProdName, RD.ItemName, -1 * RD.ProdQty, -1 * RD.SalePrice, -1 * RD.SupplyPrice, -1 * RD.BuyPrice, RD.VatRate, -1 * RD.DeliFeeAmt, RD.InvNo, RD.OrderState, RD.ReturnCmpletDate AS cmpletDate FROM shopwizard.tShpReturnDirect RD INNER JOIN shopwizard.tCmpChnl Ch ON Ch.ChnlCode = RD.ChnlCode WHERE (RD.ReturnCmpletDate IS NOT NULL AND RD.ReturnCmpletDate != '')
mapper.select: SELECT T.kind AS kind, COUNT(*) AS cnt, IFNULL(SUM(T.SalePrice),0) AS saleAmt, IFNULL(SUM(T.SupplyPrice),0) AS supplyAmt, IFNULL(SUM(T.BuyPrice),0) AS buyAmt FROM () T GROUP BY T.kind
SELECT T.ShopCode AS shopCode, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM () T GROUP BY T.ShopCode
mapper.update: UPDATE shopwizard.tShpShipDirect SET AdjustSelectDate = NOW(), ChangeId = #{changeId}, ChangeName = #{changeName}, ChangeDate = NOW() WHERE OrderNo = #{orderNo} AND OrderProdNo = #{orderProdNo} AND OrderChangeNo = #{orderChangeNo} AND (ShipCmpletDate IS NOT NULL AND ShipCmpletDate != '') AND (AdjustSelectDate IS NULL OR AdjustSelectDate = '')

UPDATE shopwizard.tShpReturnDirect SET AdjustSelectDate = NOW(), ChangeId = #{changeId}, ChangeName = #{changeName}, ChangeDate = NOW() WHERE OrderNo = #{orderNo} AND OrderProdNo = #{orderProdNo} AND OrderChangeNo = #{orderChangeNo} AND (ReturnCmpletDate IS NOT NULL AND ReturnCmpletDate != '') AND (AdjustSelectDate IS NULL OR AdjustSelectDate = '')

UPDATE shopwizard.tShpShipDirect SET AdjustSelectDate = NULL, ChangeId = #{changeId}, ChangeName = #{changeName}, ChangeDate = NOW() WHERE OrderNo = #{orderNo} AND OrderProdNo = #{orderProdNo} AND OrderChangeNo = #{orderChangeNo} AND AdjustSelectDate IS NOT NULL

UPDATE shopwizard.tShpReturnDirect SET AdjustSelectDate = NULL, ChangeId = #{changeId}, ChangeName = #{changeName}, ChangeDate = NOW() WHERE OrderNo = #{orderNo} AND OrderProdNo = #{orderProdNo} AND OrderChangeNo = #{orderChangeNo} AND AdjustSelectDate IS NOT NULL
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM shopwizard.tAdjAdjustDetail WHERE AdjustDetailNo = #{adjustDetailNo} FOR UPDATE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM shopwizard.tAdjAdjustDetail WHERE AdjustDetailNo = #{adjustDetailNo} AND BuyAdjustCloseDate IS NULL AND AdjustNo IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE shopwizard.tAdjAdjustDetail SET SupplyPrice = #{supplyPrice}, DiscntSupplyPrice = #{discntSupplyPrice}, BuyPrice = #{buyPrice}, VatRate = #{vatRate}, ChangeId = #{changeId}, ChangeName = #{changeName}, ChangeDate = NOW() WHERE AdjustDetailNo = #{adjustDetailNo} AND BuyAdjustCloseDate IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT ShopCode AS shopCode, SupplyCode AS supplyCode, SvcCode AS svcCode, adjustPeriodCode AS adjustPeriodCode FROM shopwizard.tCmpShop WHERE ShopCode = #{shopCode} FOR UPDATE
